description:
MON5CHA.DAX:49/default — ACTION IMAGEGEN PROMPT

Create only the ACTION frame of this Medusa's 128 × 128 transparent pixel-art combat animation. She is the Medusa kept near Tyranthraxus's lair: an upright humanlike woman with two planted legs, teal clothing, snake hair, and no carried equipment. Do not add a serpent tail, weapon, shield, magic beam, or scenery.

Reference image 1 is her currently installed newly generated READY sprite. It controls her identity, face, colors, clothing, five-foot body scale, camera, canvas origin, pelvis, lower body, and the exact x/y positions of both planted feet. Reference image 2 is a previously generated two-arm reaching ACTION pose, supplied only for its attack motion and expressive snakes. Its waist connection is defective: do not copy its cut or sheared torso. Reference image 3 is the user-approved bipedal pose guide, for front three-quarter screen-right facing only; do not copy the mannequin's identity or clothes. No original game artwork is a reference.

Show a late physical reach: BOTH arms emerge from their own shoulders and stretch forward together toward screen right, with BOTH hands outstretched. Move the ribcage, shoulders, neck, and head forward so the UPPER BODY visibly leans into the attack from the fixed hips and pelvis. The snakes on her head must rear UP and also lean FORWARD toward screen right into the same attack; they must not stay in their ready arrangement. Keep her chest partly visible in front three-quarter view toward screen right. This is a two-arm reach, not a punch or a gaze beam.

Draw one continuous, anatomically joined figure from neck through chest, abdomen, waist, pelvis, dress, and legs. The teal garment folds must flow across the waist without a horizontal cut, gap, doubled edge, abrupt pattern break, or displaced upper body. Keep both planted feet at their exact READY-frame x/y positions; do not step, slide, recenter, independently crop, or change body height. The attack arms and snakes may cross the 1 × 1 tile-footprint boundary. NEVER shrink or shear her body to contain them. Keep every visible pixel inside the 128 × 128 PNG canvas with transparent margin and genuine alpha. Produce a crisp, readable full-body pixel-art ACTION frame only, with no background, labels, ground plane, painted checkerboard, opaque black boxes, halos, or stray pixels.
